# Inspect Steward

> An agent that supervises evaluations, monitoring progress, diagnosing problems, and adjusting runtime state on your behalf.


## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_steward/index.html.md): Automated execution and supervision of long-running evaluations.

## Using Steward

- [Workflow](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_steward/workflow.html.md): Everything that happens in a Steward run: the workspace init creates, what launch captures and gates on, the tend loop, where the run stands, the decisions that reach a person, standing rules, pausing, cold pickup, and how a run ends.
- [Concurrency](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_steward/concurrency.html.md): The two concurrency dimensions that matter when running agentic evaluations, how sandboxes, samples, tasks, and model connections are bounded, and how Steward's automatic ramp discovers sample concurrency.
- [Error Handling](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_steward/errors.html.md): How Steward tunes inspect's error handling for unattended runs: what it retries automatically, what it surfaces as decisions, how a decision becomes standing policy, and how errors are resolved before signoff.
- [Scanners](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_steward/scanners.html.md): How Steward scans transcripts for scoring integrity problems: the built-in scanner, choosing a scan model, adding your own, and what a finding asks of you.
- [Agent Runbook](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_steward/runbook.html.md): The operating instructions Steward ships to the coding agent supervising a run, reproduced verbatim.

## Integrations

- [Inspect Flow](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_steward/flow.html.md): Running an Inspect Flow spec under Steward: installation, what Steward overrides in a worker, and the two declarations that do not survive.
- [Inspect Hawk](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_steward/hawk.html.md): Running a Hawk eval set config under Steward: installation, how concurrency is set, what a local Hawk run cannot do, and what fan-out costs at startup.
